GOAL: orient in the workspace before proposing.
READ: list_directory of workshop root -> only progress.jsonl; no repo, no config readable.
OBSERVED: no code/config available, so K, L, d and the exact baseline loss must be stated as "as in the frozen baseline config" and all new constants must be documented defaults, not swept values.
REASONING: since the earlier rounds already occupied (a) successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates, (b) per-level curvature set by prefix-transition score, (c) behaviour-ranked radial assignment / branch-curvature experts, I choose a different coupling POSITION: the residual recursion itself. Behaviour enters as a per-item FRAME (successor anchor) into which each level's residual is re-expressed, and curvature enters as the Mobius add/subtract + exp/log that move the residual between frames; the decoder inverts the same isometries.
OPEN: write the full spec (equation, inputs/outputs, safeguards, cost at 24556 items / 24 steps / 3000 epochs) and the 2x2 ablation semantics.

IDEA: SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ
TITLE: Successor-framed residual quantization: each RQ level re-expresses the residual in a behaviour anchor frame using Mobius isometries, so the whole SID prefix hierarchy is quantized relative to where the item's train-split successors live.
MOTIVATION: In a plain RQ-VAE every prefix level quantizes the same item vector, so a coarse prefix and its refinements all describe the item alone; the generative recommender must then learn, from Stage 3 data alone, which refinements actually discriminate the item from its behavioural neighbours. Items that sit inside one behaviour cluster get deep prefix bits spent on directions that no successor distinguishes, while the direction toward the successor region (the only one Stage 3 needs) is not privileged. The mechanism forces the deeper prefixes to encode the offset of the item from its successor region instead of restating the item.
NOVELTY: Earlier rounds modified the codebook (successor-weighted Frechet updates), the curvature scalar (per-level transition score), or the assignment weight/radius (behaviour-ranked radial assignment, branch-curvature experts). Here nothing about the codebook update, the assignment weight or the curvature scalar changes: the change is the residual PATH. The residual is carried between frames by Mobius isometries (Mobius subtraction of the chosen codeword, Mobius addition of a frozen behaviour anchor), and the decoder inverts exactly those isometries. Removing the behaviour term reduces the recursion to a plain curved RQ (Mobius residual, geodesic reconstruction); removing curvature reduces it to Euclidean RQ with an additive behaviour offset. Neither switch leaves the other intact.
KEY_CHANGE: Replace p_l = p_{l-1} - c_l (Euclidean residual) with p_l = (p_{l-1} (-) C_l[k_l]) (+) A_l(i) in the Poincare ball, where A_l(i) is a frozen per-item successor anchor, and decode by the exact inverse recursion q_{L}=0, q_{l-1} = (q_l (-) A_l(i)) (+) C_l[k_l], with a geodesic reconstruction loss.
SPECIFICATION: Curvature fixed at c=1 (unit Poincare ball, documented default, not tuned). Encoder output z_i in R^d, clipped to ||z_i||<=R=atanh(0.9)=1.4722, point x_i=exp_0(z_i)=tanh(||z_i||) z_i/||z_i||. Codebooks stored as tangent tables W_l in R^{K x d}, points C_l=exp_0(W_l) (K, L as in the frozen baseline config). BEHAVIOUR ANCHOR, computed ONCE before Stage 2 and frozen: build the row-normalised directed transition matrix M (rows = items, M[i,v] = count(i->v)/sum_v count(i->v)) from TRAIN-split session transitions only; take a rank-d randomised SVD M ~ U S V^T with a fixed RNG seed and a fixed sign convention (flip each left-singular column so its largest-magnitude entry is positive); item factor b_i = (U S^{1/2})_i; anchor tangent t_i = tau * b_i / max(||b_i||, eps) with tau = atanh(0.5) = 0.5493 (documented mid-ball default) and t_i = 0 when item i has no train successor; a_i = exp_0(t_i); store A_l(i) = exp_0(0.5^{l-1} * t_i), l = 1..L (rho = 0.5 documented geometric contraction so the accumulated frame offset sum_l rho^{l-1} < 2 stays bounded; it makes level 1 carry the full successor offset and finer levels the shrunken remainder). ENCODE: p_0 = x_i; for l=1..L: k_l = argmin_k d_c(p_{l-1}, C_l[k]); p_l = (p_{l-1} (-) C_l[k_l]) (+) A_l(i), where x (-) y = x (+) (-y) and (+) is Mobius addition. DECODE: q_L = 0; for l=L..1: q_{l-1} = (q_l (-) A_l(i)) (+) C_l[k_l]; x_hat_i = q_0; the inversion is exact because the encoding step is an isometry compo

sition. LOSS: L_rec = mean_i d_c(x_i, x_hat_i)^2 with d_c(x,y) = 2 artanh(||(-x) (+) y||); the baseline's commitment and codebook-usage terms are kept with the same weights, with the commitment term evaluated on log_0(p_{l-1}) against W_l[k_l]. Straight-through code selection as in the baseline. SID = (k_1, ..., k_L) from the same recursion at the end of training. COST: one-off randomised rank-d SVD of a 24556 x 24556 sparse matrix (~123k nnz, seconds to ~1 min); anchors stored 24556 x L x d float32 (~9 MB at d=32, L=3). Per step (batch ~1024 at 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs = 72000 steps): L extra Mobius subtractions, L+? Mobius additions, 2L exp/log on d-vectors and one extra exp per level for the decode: about 6*L vector ops of size 1024 x 32, i.e. well under 1% of the transformer's per-step FLOPs; the added codebook distance work is zero (same K-way argmin as baseline). Expected wall clock 1.02-1.10x baseline, memory +~10 MB, no extra forward/backward passes, no extra training epochs.
HYPOTHESIS: If the successor frame is the right carrier for prefix refinement, then level-2/3 codes of items inside one behaviour cluster will diverge according to which part of the successor region the item points to, geodesic reconstruction loss will fall for the same number of levels, and Stage 3 test Recall@10 will exceed 0.065 (baseline Euclidean RQ framing) with no change to codebook size, loss weights or epochs; observed by comparing the logged test_recall@10 against 0.065 and by the shift in the level-2/3 code histogram versus a Euclidean-framing run.
RISKS: ["Sparse/tail items: most items have <2 train successors, so their anchor is near-origin and the mechanism degenerates to plain curved RQ for exactly the items where SIDs matter least; the head may dominate the gain.","SVD factors of the transition matrix are popularity-driven, so the anchor may encode popularity rather than a behaviour direction, which the popularity-skewed recall metric may or may not reward.","Mobius recursion can drift: accumulated frame offsets push p_l toward the ball boundary where artanh gradients saturate and the straight-through code choice becomes unstable.","Geodesic reconstruction loss replaces the baseline's squared Euclidean loss; any recall change could be attributed to the loss rather than to the frame coupling, which a single run cannot separate (the coupling's own check is the two switches, not an extra arm).","Rank-d randomised SVD of the row-normalised matrix is a hyperparameter in disguise (rank d); it is fixed to the encoder width, not chosen by validation.","If the encoder collapses to near-origin points (common in RQ-VAE), exp/log behave almost linearly and the curvature barely acts, so the both-on arm may look Euclidean."]
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item-to-item transitions from TRAIN-split sessions (next-item edges), summarised as each item's successor-profile anchor in the Poincare ball.
BEHAVIOR_COMPUTATION: From the training split only: for each ordered pair (i, v) that occurs as consecutive items in a training session, increment count(i->v); row-normalise to get M; b = (U S^{1/2}) from a seeded rank-d randomised SVD of M; t_i = tau * b_i/||b_i||; a_i = exp_0(t_i); A_l(i) = exp_0(0.5^{l-1} t_i). Computed once before Stage 2 starts, stored as a frozen tensor with no gradient, and reused for every epoch and for the final SID assignment. Popularity adjustment is implicit: row normalisation removes each source's activity, and the SVD's leading factor

absorbs global popularity.
LEAKAGE_BOUNDARY: The transition matrix, its SVD, and therefore every anchor A_l(i) are built exclusively from train-split sessions before Stage 2 begins, are frozen with requires_grad=False, and are never recomputed during training or at evaluation. No validation or test interaction (and no Stage 3 prefix/successor statistic) enters SID construction; validation items are used only to log reconstruction on the standard protocol, and the anchors of not-yet-seen items are simply the frozen train-split values (origin if the item has no train successor).
HYPERBOLIC_OPERATOR: Fixed negative curvature c=1 Poincare ball: Mobius addition/subtraction (+),(-), exp_0/log_0 maps, and the Poincare distance d_c(x,y)=2 artanh(||(-x)(+)y||) used both inside the residual recursion and as the reconstruction metric. No trainable curvature, so no curvature sweep is possible.
HYPERBOLIC_LOCATION: Inside the residual quantizer of Stage 2 (the encoding recursion p_l and the decode recursion q_{l-1}) and in the reconstruction loss; i.e. it acts on quantization, not on the recommender backbone.
COUPLING_PATH: The single pathway is the residual update itself: p_l = (p_{l-1} (-) C_l[k_l]) (+) A_l(i). The behaviour anchor A_l(i) is the point of the Mobius addition that the next level's codeword is measured against, so the next level's argmin, and hence every deeper prefix code, depends on the anchor. Replacing A_l(i) by the origin removes the behaviour term and leaves the plain curved RQ; replacing Mobius add/subtract and exp/log/d_c by +,-,identity,L2 removes the geometry, including the anchor's action.
COUPLING_EQUATION: p_l = (p_{l-1} (-)_c C_l[k_l]) (+)_c A_l(i), A_l(i) = exp_0^c( rho^{l-1} * tau * b_i / ||b_i|| ), k_l = argmin_k d_c^c(p_{l-1}, exp_0^c(W_l[k])), L_rec = mean_i [ d_c^c(x_i, x_hat_i) ]^2.
OBSERVABLES: (1) level-2 and level-3 code identity and code histogram for items with non-degenerate anchors, versus the same items under Euclidean framing; (2) geodesic reconstruction loss per level (a curve that is flat after level 1 means the frame is doing nothing); (3) prefix-to-successor transfer predictability (agreement of the shared-prefix group's successor sets with the successor anchors) recorded as a diagnostic only; (4) the number of items whose nearest codeword changes when the anchor is removed at inference time (frame sensitivity); (5) Stage 3 test_recall@10 against the 0.065 bar.
ABLATION_BEHAVIOR_OFF: Set A_l(i) = 0 (origin) for all items and all levels; the recursion becomes p_l = p_{l-1} (-) C_l[k_l] with decode q_{l-1} = q_l (+) C_l[k_l], i.e. exact Mobius residual RQ with geodesic reconstruction and no successor information. The switch is a single boolean that zeroes the frozen anchor table; it exists in the code but is never run in this round.
ABLATION_GEOMETRY_OFF: Take the flat limit c->0: exp_0 and log_0 become the identity, (+) becomes +, (-) becomes -, d_c becomes L2; the recursion becomes p_l = p_{l-1} - e_l + A_l^{Euclid}(i) with decode x_hat = sum_l e_l - sum_l A_l^{Euclid}(i) and the anchors t_i used unscaled in R^d. Behaviour is still on, curvature is off. One boolean selects the operator set; never run in this round.
ABLATION_BOTH_ON: The full recursion with c=1 Mobius operators and the frozen successor anchors at every level (and the exact inverse decode), trained once for the frozen 3000 Stage 2 epochs and evaluated once by the frozen Stage 3 protocol.
SPEC_EQUATIONS: c=1; R=atanh(0.9)=1.4722; tau=at

anh(0.5)=0.5493; rho=0.5. exp_0(v)=tanh(||v||) v/||v|| (0 at v=0); log_0(x)=artanh(||x||) x/||x||; x(+)(-x)=0; x(+)y = ((1+2<x,y>+||y||^2) x + (1-||x||^2) y)/(1+2<x,y>+||x||^2||y||^2) for c=1; d_c(x,y)=2 artanh(||(-x)(+)y||). Precompute: M[row-normalised train transitions]; [U,S,~] = rsvd(M, d); b=(U S^{1/2}); sign-fix columns; t_i = tau b_i/max(||b_i||,1e-8) if i has a successor else 0; A_l(i)=exp_0(rho^{l-1} t_i). Encode: z=E(i); z=clip_norm(z,R); x=exp_0(z); p=x; for l=1..L: dist_k = d_c(p, exp_0(W_l[k])) for k=1..K; k_l=argmin; p = (p (-) exp_0(W_l[k_l])) (+) A_l(i). Decode: q=0; for l=L..1: q = (q (-) A_l(i)) (+) exp_0(W_l[k_l]); x_hat=q. Loss: L_rec = mean_i d_c(x_i,x_hat_i)^2; L = L_rec + beta_cm * mean_{i,l} ||log_0(p_{l-1}) - W_l[k_l]||^2 + baseline usage term, with beta_cm and the usage weight exactly as the baseline config (no new weights). Straight-through straight to codebooks. SID_i=(k_1..k_L) from the trained recursion.
SPEC_INPUTS_OUTPUTS: Inputs: encoder tangents z_i (batch x d), codebook tangent tables W_l (K x d), frozen anchor tangents t_i (num_items x d), booleans use_behaviour and use_curvature, curvature c=1. Outputs: chosen code tuple (k_1..k_L) per item, reconstructed ball point x_hat_i, scalar geodesic reconstruction loss and its gradient with respect to the encoder output and to W_l.
SAFEGUARDS: clip every tangent norm to R=atanh(0.9) before exp_0 so ball points stay at radius <=0.9 and d_c never evaluates artanh at 1; clamp the Mobius-addition denominator to >=1e-8 and clamp ||(-x)(+)y|| to <=1-1e-7 before artanh; use the numerically stable form of Mobius addition that divides by (1+2<x,y>+||x||^2||y||^2) after subtracting a running max of the batch norms where available; define exp_0(0)=0 and log_0(0)=0 by convention; anchor rows for items with no train successor are exactly zero so those items fall back to the plain curved RQ recursion; the entire anchor tensor is a frozen buffer (requires_grad=False) built with a fixed seed and a deterministic SVD sign convention so the run is reproducible; rho=0.5 and tau=atanh(0.5) are documented defaults, never swept, and c=1 is fixed so there is no curvature search; the reconstruction is checked once at step 0 to satisfy d_c(x_i, x_hat_i) < 1e-3 when codes are set to the exact per-level residuals, which validates the decode inversion before training.
END IDEA
